correctness.rationale: The six published cyclic generators reconstruct f=(15,105,180,90). Exact bit-vector elimination gives rank(d2)=88 and rank(d3)=89, so H2(F2) has dimension three. Every vertex subset of size at most seven is exhaustively analyzed through its full local 2-cycle space and reduction modulo global tetrahedral boundaries. No subset of size at most six carries a nonzero ambient class; exactly sixty seven-subsets do. Every one has induced f=(7,21,14), no tetrahedra, edge degree two, and a globally consistent orientation, so it is a torus. Their ambient classes occur with exact multiplicities 15,15,15,15 and the stated basis relation. All 120 published affine symmetries are replayed on the exact tetrahedron set.

value.rationale: The fifteen-vertex complex is the classical smallest known and maximally symmetric triangulation of T3. Determining the minimum vertex support of nonzero middle-dimensional homology is a natural combinatorial systolic question. The answer is structurally strong rather than a routine count: every minimizer is itself a vertex-minimal torus, all sixty lie in one ambient symmetry orbit, yet they occupy exactly four of seven nonzero H2(F2) classes with perfect 15-fold balance.
